title: Robinhood Agentic MCP exposes place_option_order, but ChatGPT/Codex refuses to submit—has anyone solved this?
author: EthanCC8
selftext:
I connected Robinhood’s official streamable-HTTP MCP to Codex. Discovery and read-only calls work, and the dedicated account returns `agentic_allowed=true`. Both `review_option_order` and `place_option_order` appear in the tool list.

`review_option_order` is callable, but Codex refuses to invoke `place_option_order` even after an explicit, transaction-specific confirmation. I understand that [`AGENTS.md`](http://AGENTS.md), sandbox settings, and `approval_policy` operate at different layers.

Has anyone reproduced this specifically in Codex Desktop or Codex CLI? Is the refusal an immutable host policy, a product-surface difference, or an MCP approval configuration issue? Please include Codex version/client and relevant non-sensitive configuration.

comments.author: TourHorror9247
comments.body:
Gpt and Claude will not allow live trading . I had this problem with Tradingview MCP too.

Switch models. K3 or deepseek v4 flash/pro
